projects.title: Greenie Culture
projects.description: Smart Eco Plant Management System. A comprehensive platform for plant enthusiasts to purchase, manage, and track the health of their indoor gardens.

details.problem: Plant lovers often struggle with maintaining plant health and finding a reliable source for purchasing diverse plant species.
details.solution: Developed a comprehensive management system that tracks plant health and provides a seamless e-commerce experience for plant enthusiasts using the MEAN stack.
details.challenges: Integrating real-time health tracking data and managing a large inventory of plant species with varying care requirements.
details.learnings: Deepened knowledge in MEAN stack development and implementing efficient database schemas for complex inventory management.

projects.title: Aura Soap
projects.description: Luxury handmade soap e-commerce platform with an editorial aesthetic and a focus on natural ingredients.

details.problem: Generic soap brands lack the artisanal touch and detailed ingredient transparency that luxury consumers demand.
details.solution: Built a premium boutique experience that combines editorial-style storytelling with a streamlined shopping cart and secure checkout.
details.challenges: Implementing high-performance image rendering for luxury product shots and building a responsive boutique-style layout.
details.learnings: Mastered Next.js server-side rendering for SEO optimization and refined CSS transitions for a high-end feel.

projects.title: Health & Fitness Club
projects.description: Comprehensive fitness club management system featuring workout tracking, trainer booking, and membership management.

details.problem: Gym members often struggle to track their progress and book sessions efficiently across multiple platforms.
details.solution: Integrated all club operations into a single MERN-stack dashboard, providing real-time tracking and seamless scheduling.
details.challenges: Managing complex state for real-time workout updates and ensuring a highly responsive UI for mobile users in the gym.
details.learnings: Gained deep experience in MERN stack integration and implementing secure user authentication for member data privacy.

projects.title: Clothing Store
projects.description: Modern fashion e-commerce platform with dynamic category filtering and a seamless shopping experience.

details.problem: Online fashion shoppers need a fast, intuitive way to browse collections and manage their style preferences.
details.solution: Developed a high-performance clothing store using Next.js, featuring real-time inventory and a refined user interface.
details.challenges: Optimizing large product catalogs and ensuring pixel-perfect responsiveness across all devices.
details.learnings: Deepened understanding of e-commerce state management and advanced Next.js optimization techniques.

blogs.title: The Art of the 100ms Page Load
blogs.excerpt: Technical breakdown of optimization techniques including code-splitting, tree-shaking, and the power of CDN edges.
blogs.content: Optimizing web performance isn't just about small assets; it's about the critical rendering path. In this article, I explore how modern frameworks like Vite and Next.js handle data hydration and how we can prune unnecessary execution to achieve instantaneous interaction.

blogs.title: Clean Code in the Age of AI Co-pilots
blogs.excerpt: How to maintain architectural integrity when using AI tools for rapid prototyping and logic generation.
blogs.content: As AI becomes a standard part of our IDE, the role of a developer shifts from a writer to an editor. We must hold AI-generated code to the same (if not higher) standards of readability and testability that we set for ourselves.
